frontmatter.title: Excel, CSV 또는 TXT에서 QLab 자막을 빠르게 만드는 방법
frontmatter.description: 스프레드시트나 일반 텍스트에서 QLab 5 Text cues를 만드는 실무 workflow와 QLab 공식 문서, SurtitleLive QLab Sync 비교.

body:
이미 QLab으로 공연을 운용한다면 느린 부분은 보통 프로젝터가 아닙니다. 느린 부분은 대본, 번역, Excel, CSV, TXT를 show file을 망가뜨리지 않고 수많은 cue 가능한 자막 줄로 바꾸는 일입니다. QLab operator에게 필요한 것은 리허설, 이동, 재번호 부여, 본番 실행이 가능한 **Text cues**입니다. ## QLab이 자막을 표시할 수 있나요? 네. QLab 5의 Text cues는 스타일 텍스트를 video output으로 렌더링하고 video output stage에 할당할 수 있으므로 projected subtitles/surtitles에 적합합니다. ## QLab 공식 문서와의 비교 ![Boring Excel spreadsheet structure for QLab subtitles](./blog-13-2.png) *Download the template here: [QLab Subtitles Excel Template (XLSX)](./blog-13-xlsx.xlsx)* ![Boring Excel spreadsheet structure for QLab subtitles](./blog-13-2.png) *Download the template here: [QLab Subtitles Excel Template (XLSX)](./blog-13-xlsx.xlsx)* | 필요 | QLab 공식 기능 | 이 글의 workflow | | --- | --- | --- | | Projection | Text cues는 video output으로 표시됩니다. | 자막 하나 = Text cue 하나. | | 대량 생성 | AppleScript는 `make type "text"`와 `text`, `text alignment`, `fixed width`, `stage name`을 지원합니다. | spreadsheet row 또는 TXT block에서 cue 생성. | | Spreadsheet | QLab Cookbook은 Excel-driven cue generation 예제를 제공합니다. | 이를 subtitle/surtitle에 적용합니다. | | XLSX import | 공식 문서는 automation이지 native one-click subtitle import가 아닙니다. | Excel/CSV/TXT를 source data로 사용합니다. | | Audience phones | QLab은 local projection을 처리합니다. | SurtitleLive QLab Sync가 phones를 동기화합니다. | 정확한 표현은 **Excel, CSV, TXT에서 spreadsheet-driven 또는 script-driven workflow로 QLab subtitle Text cues를 만들 수 있다**입니다. ## 빠른 구조 `cue_number`, `subtitle_text`, `operator_note`, `language`, `stage`, `alignment`를 사용하고, 한 행에 자막 하나를 둡니다. ```csv cue_number,subtitle_text 10,Welcome to the show. 11,Please turn off your phones. 12,The performance will begin shortly. ``` ## Excel → QLab Text cues Excel에서 subtitles를 정리하고 QLab 5 workspace를 열며 Text cue template을 만든 뒤 AppleScript로 각 row에서 Text cue를 생성합니다. ```applescript tell application id "com.microsoft.Excel" to tell worksheet 1 set theRowCount to count of rows of used range end tell tell application id "com.figure53.QLab.5" to tell front workspace -- Create a temporary import group so generated cues are easy to review make type "group" set importGroup to last item of (selected as list) set mode of importGroup to timeline set q number of importGroup to "SUBS" set q name of importGroup to "Generated subtitles from Excel" set lastTextCue to "" repeat with rowIndex from 2 to theRowCount tell application id "com.microsoft.Excel" to tell worksheet 1 set theCueNumber to (value of cell 1 of row rowIndex) as text set theSubtitleText to (value of cell 2 of row rowIndex) as text set theOperatorNote to "" try set theOperatorNote to (value of cell 3 of row rowIndex) as text end try end tell -- Skip blank rows if theCueNumber is not "" and theSubtitleText is not "" then -- Create a Group cue (Timeline mode) for this subtitle step make type "group" set subGroup to last item of (selected as list) set mode of subGroup to timeline set q number of subGroup to theCueNumber set q name of subGroup to "Subtitle " & theCueNumber -- Move the group into the import container move subGroup to end of importGroup make type "text" set currentTextCue to last item of (selected as list) set q name of currentTextCue to "Text " & theCueNumber set text of currentTextCue to theSubtitleText move currentTextCue to end of subGroup -- If there is a previous subtitle, create a Fade cue to fade it out if lastTextCue is not "" then make type "fade" set theFade to last item of (selected as list) set q name of theFade to "Fade Out Previous" set cue target of theFade to lastTextCue set duration of theFade to 0.05 set stop target when done of theFade to true set do opacity of theFade to true set opacity of theFade to 0 move theFade to end of subGroup -- Current text cue waits 0.05s for the previous one to fade out set pre wait of currentTextCue to 0.05 end if -- Apply layout settings to the Text cue set theCue to currentTextCue set text alignment of theCue to "center" set fixed width of theCue to 1600 set notes of theCue to theOperatorNote set lastTextCue to currentTextCue end if end repeat end tell ``` ![QLab cue list showing batch generated subtitle group cues](./blog-13-1.png) *You can download the complete companion package containing this AppleScript, the Excel template, and screenshot here: [QLab Subtitles Demo Assets (ZIP)](./blog-13-qlab-subtitles-demo-assets.zip).* ![QLab cue list showing batch generated subtitle group cues](./blog-13-1.png) *You can download the complete companion package containing this AppleScript, the Excel template, and screenshot here: [QLab Subtitles Demo Assets (ZIP)](./blog-13-qlab-subtitles-demo-assets.zip).* 실제 show에서는 empty/duplicate cue number, long lines, draft rows, stage assignment를 반드시 체크하고 temporary group 또는 별도 workspace에서 먼저 검토합니다. ## CSV / TXT CSV는 automation과 Git review에 좋습니다. TXT는 작은 event에는 빠르지만 multiple languages, approval status, operator notes, version history에는 약합니다. ```txt 10 Welcome to the show. 11 Please turn off your phones. ``` ## Projection setup ![QLab Text cue inspector showing video stage assignment in the I/O tab](./blog-13-4.gif) ![QLab Text cue inspector showing video stage assignment in the I/O tab](./blog-13-4.gif) projector/display, video output stage, font, size, color, width, position, back-row readability를 먼저 테스트하세요. 흔한 실패는 duplicated cue numbers, missing stage, bad line breaks, translation changes, projection/mobile drift입니다. ## SurtitleLive를 사용할 때 local projection만 필요하면 QLab Text cues로 충분할 수 있습니다. translation review, stable cue keys, multiple languages, mobile viewing 또는 projection + audience phones가 필요하면 SurtitleLive가 더 적합합니다. **QLab Projection Pack:** **SurtitleLive Editor → QLab Projection Pack → QLab Text cues → projector** **QLab + SurtitleLive Cloud Sync:** **QLab → local projection → projector** **QLab sync cue → local Mac bridge → SurtitleLive Cloud → audience phones** ```mermaid graph TD %% Style Definitions classDef qlab fill:#1a1c23,stroke:#5856d6,stroke-width:2px,color:#fff; classDef hardware fill:#2a2b36,stroke:#8e8e93,stroke-width:2px,color:#fff; classDef cloud fill:#0d2d5e,stroke:#007aff,stroke-width:2px,color:#fff; classDef audience fill:#103823,stroke:#34c759,stroke-width:2px,color:#fff; subgraph Venue ["Local Venue (Theatre)"] QLab["QLab 5 Workspace

Millisecond-level Push"| PhoneN %% Subgraph Styling style Venue fill:#f9f9fb,stroke:#ccc,stroke-width:1px; style CloudSpace fill:#f0f7ff,stroke:#b3d7ff,stroke-width:1px; style Viewers fill:#f2fff5,stroke:#c2f0cc,stroke-width:1px; ``` QLab은 show timeline을 유지하고 SurtitleLive는 mobile subtitle state를 관리합니다. ## FAQ QLab은 Text cues로 자막을 표시할 수 있습니다. Excel은 native import가 아니라 automation으로 처리합니다. CSV/TXT는 importer가 있으면 가능합니다. editable live text에는 Text cues가 적합하고, audience phone sync에는 SurtitleLive QLab Sync 같은 browser/mobile workflow가 필요합니다. ## 관련 리소스 - QLab 5 Text Cues: https://qlab.app/docs/v5/video/text-cues/ - QLab 5 AppleScript Dictionary: https://qlab.app/docs/v5/scripting/applescript-dictionary-v5/ - QLab Cookbook — Grid: https://qlab.app/cookbook/grid/ - SurtitleLive QLab workflow: https://surtitlelive.com/qlab
